name: BRCA2 DNA repair associated

function.text: BRCA2 encodes a tumor-suppressor protein that loads and regulates RAD51 at damaged DNA, supporting accurate repair of double-strand breaks by homologous recombination.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to BRCA2-related cancer predisposition (autosomal dominant); Fanconi anemia complementation group D1 (autosomal recessive). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Prostate adenocarcinoma; Pancreatic acinar cell carcinoma; Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

function.text: BRCA2 encodes a tumor-suppressor protein that loads and regulates RAD51 at damaged DNA, supporting accurate repair of double-strand breaks by homologous recombination.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with BRCA2-related cancer predisposition (autosomal dominant); Fanconi anemia complementation group D1 (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving BRCA2 have been reported in invasive breast carcinoma, high-grade serous carcinoma, tubo-ovarian / peritoneal, and prostate adenocarcinoma.
